headline: OPEN
reason: Work order §5 orders fibration/conic/multisection search before raw elimination. C0.2 found no conic bundle or rational fibration on F14_T (rho=1). Elimination of the common-isotropic system is the residual arithmetic attack, but it requires installed Option-1 (or Option-2) coefficients first. Running five-equation elimination without certified H_T would be empty theatre or a memory-saturating placeholder solve.

data_required: split-model check dim=3, deg=14, smooth passed by independent verifier

proposed_system_after_model.name: common_isotropic_line_affine_chart
proposed_system_after_model.expected_term_shape: each Fr is a quadratic form in the eight scalar coordinates (Hermitian weight 2); term counts depend on the installed (a,b) and H_r and are unknown until C0-MODEL-PASS
proposed_system_after_model.note: The five forms are special (Moore determinant recovers twisted Klein cubic). Do not cite general five-quadric singular-locus bounds.

checkpoint_plan.action: Serialize F1..F5 with self-hashes; record bit-sizes of coefficients in K_proj model
checkpoint_plan.abort_if: coefficient bit-size or term count exceeds pre-agreed envelope

checkpoint_plan.action: Modular Gröbner discovery at two good primes p≠67; record LM, dim, degree of special fibre
checkpoint_plan.abort_if: empty solver output (treat as failed run, not empty variety)

checkpoint_plan.action: If modular fibres suggest rational points of small height, lift by Hensel/CRT with implemented final congruence check and holdout prime
Characteristic-zero Gröbner or resultant only on a scoped chart with dimension certificate plan; never affine hyperplane as dim certificate
checkpoint_plan.abort_if: memory > authorized envelope or no exact reconstruction path

checkpoint_plan.action: Any candidate q substituted into all five original Hermitian equations; recompute that q is nonzero right D-line

certificate_type_if_success.must_prove: point lies on F14_T, not merely on P2_D or auxiliary Pfaffian cubic in Sym(A,sigma)
certificate_type_if_success.bridge: Arrow B then C of BRIDGE_AUDIT.md (incidence to C_gen, then ed/unirationality)

certificate_type_if_empty.exit: scoped emptiness only — not automatic headline negative
certificate_type_if_empty.note: Emptiness of one affine chart is not emptiness of F14_T; all three charts and projective closure required

verifier_design.decisive_invariant: recompute h_r(q,q)=0 in D from serialized matrices and q; recompute Nrd coordinates; do not trust JSON booleans
verifier_design.split_check_independent: on a splitting extension, recompute dim/deg/smooth of the classical linear section from the same matrices
verifier_design.modular: final congruence + holdout prime; never sole fibre p=67

resource_envelope_suggestion.note: Larger than C0 structural fence; requires director authorization after C0-MODEL-PASS
resource_envelope_suggestion.stagger: must not overlap T8 or P25Y memory-saturating jobs

c0_2_implication: No conic-bundle shortcut reduces codimension before elimination. The codimension-five section problem remains the residual path once the model exists.
